meta.first_line: bhāi-re! śorīra avidyā-jāl, joḍendriya tāhe kāl
meta.author: Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur

text: tā’ra madhye jihvā ati,    lobhamoy sudurmati,
word_by_word: **bhāi** — brother; **re** — O!; **śorīra** — body; **avidyā** — ignorance's; **jāl** — net; **joḍendriya** — material senses (jada indriya); **tāhe** — therein; **kāl** — deadly; **jīve** — soul; **phele** — throws; **viṣaya** — sense enjoyment; **sāgore** — into the ocean; **tā’ra** — them; **madhye** — among; **jihvā** — the tongue; **ati** — most; **lobhamoy** — full of greed; **sudurmati** — very wicked; **tā’ke** — that; **jetā** — to conquer; **koṭhina** — difficult; **saṁsāre** — in this material world.
translation: Oh brothers! This material body is a network of ignorance, and the senses are one’s deadly enemies, for they throw the soul into the ocean of material sense enjoyment. Among the senses, the tongue is the most voracious and verily wicked; it is very difficult to conquer the tongue in this world.

text: kṛṣṇa boḍo dayāmoy,    koribāre jihvā jay,
word_by_word: **kṛṣṇa** — Krsna; **boḍo** — very; **dayāmoy** — merciful; **koribāre** — in order to; **jihvā** — the tongue; **jay** — conquer; **sva** — His own; **prasād** — prasādam; **anna** — food, grains; **dilo** — gave; **bhāi** — O brother; **sei** — that; **annāmṛta** — food like nectar; **pāo** — accept; **rādhā** — Rādhā; **kṛṣṇa** — Krşņa; **guṇa** — glories; **gāo** — sing; **preme** — with love; **ḍāko** — call out; **chaitanya** — Chaitanya; **nitāi** — Nitāi!.
translation: Oh brothers! Lord Krishna is very merciful—just to control the tongue He has given us the remnants of His own food! Now please eat these nectarean grains while singing the glories of Their Lordships Śrī Śrī RādhāKrishna, and in love call out Chaitanya! Nitāi!

text: (dayāl nitāi chaitanya bole, preme bhore ḍākare)
word_by_word: **preme** — with love; **bhore** — filled; **ḍākare** — chant!; **dayāl** — merciful; **nitāi** — Nitāi; **chaitanya** — Chaitanya; **bole** — chant; **preme** — with love; **bhore** — filled; **ḍākare** — chant!; **nitāi** — Nitāi; **gaura** — Gaura; **haribol** — chant "Hari!".
